summary: Narrow, tree-covered lane with homes close by and no visible room to pull off.
reasons: No clear room to pull off the lane
Homes within 5-23 m along most of it
Mostly canopy-hidden narrow track, access unclear

drivers.seclusion: Bushy on the east side, but homes sit 5-30 m away along the whole stretch, with several right at the road.
drivers.access_and_room: After the first 10 m the lane narrows to a track under canopy; no clear pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Very little traffic; it serves a few driveways.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park at the start near the bend, nothing further along.

flags: Mean grade 3.3%, max 11.8% (steepest in the first 30 m)
Dwellings within 25 m of most of the stretch
Low-lying, near 33 m elevation; no waterway within 175 m
sun_shade: Heavy canopy over almost the whole stretch.
cannot_judge: Surface and width under the canopy
Whether the track is public access
